title: The stem cell atlas of lung adenocarcinoma: A stemness blueprint for prognosis and immunotherapy success.
authors: Yin, Jiacheng; Jin, Xing; Hu, Zhengyang; Yang, Huiqiang; Huo, Shuhua; Sun, Fenghao; Jiang, Wei; Wang, Qun; Sui, Qihai; Shi, Yu; Chen, Zhencong
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞和谱系追踪描绘肺腺癌干细胞的转录重编程图谱，虽涉及转录因子表达，但核心是肿瘤干细胞与免疫治疗，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are involved in tumor initiation, metastasis, therapeutic resistance, and heterogeneity of aggressive lung adenocarcinomas (LUADs). Although identification of CSCs through cell surface markers expression defines the CSC compartment, it provides little information on molecular mechanisms underlying the biological behaviors of CSCs. The CSC-driving tumor evolution path is also largely unknown due to technical difficulties. This study aimed to comprehensively depict the landscape of LUAD CSCs at the single-cell and molecular levels. Through flow cytometry and lineage tracing, we reconstructed LUAD CSCs trajectories with patient-derived samples and identified a persistent stem-like population with distinct molecular signatures through all tumor stages. CSC-related pathways, transcription factors (TFs) and metabolic characteristics were differentially expressed along LUAD progression, which revealed that developmental trajectory and tumor heterogeneity were driven by multistep transcriptional reprogramming of CSCs. Moreover, CSCs might promote LUAD progression through the S100A9-pNF-kappaB axis. We discovered a specific stemness signature with genetic profiles along the tumor progression and significantly correlated with clinical outcomes. Notably, by integrating bulk tumor data from TCGA, molecular clustering based on the CSC stemness signature well-distinguished clinical features and genomic or immune alterations, with the high stemness index group exhibiting reduced immune activity and a tendency towards cold tumors. Overall, our results provided unique perspectives into previously unappreciated molecular dynamics of CSC subpopulations driving LUAD evolution. The stemness signature tailored personalized risk assessment and immunotherapy strategies for individual LUAD patients.
abstract_zh: 癌症干细胞（CSCs）参与侵袭性肺腺癌（LUADs）的肿瘤起始、转移、治疗耐药及异质性。尽管通过细胞表面标志物表达鉴定CSCs可界定CSC区室，但对其生物学行为背后的分子机制提供的信息甚少。由于技术困难，CSC驱动的肿瘤演化路径也 largely 未知。本研究旨在单细胞和分子水平全面描绘LUAD CSCs的景观。通过流式细胞术和谱系追踪，我们利用患者来源样本重建了LUAD CSCs轨迹，并识别出在所有肿瘤阶段中具有独特分子特征的持续干细胞样群体。CSC相关通路、转录因子（TFs）和代谢特征在LUAD进展过程中差异表达，揭示发育轨迹和肿瘤异质性由CSCs的多步转录重编程驱动。此外，CSCs可能通过S100A9-pNF-kappaB轴促进LUAD进展。我们发现了一种沿肿瘤进展具有遗传特征的特异性干性签名，并与临床结果显著相关。值得注意的是，通过整合TCGA的 bulk 肿瘤数据，基于CSC干性签名的分子聚类能很好地区分临床特征及基因组或免疫改变，其中高干性指数组表现出降低的免疫活性和趋向冷肿瘤的倾向。总体而言，我们的结果为先前未被重视的驱动LUAD演化的CSC亚群分子动态提供了独特视角。该干性签名为个体化LUAD患者定制了风险评估和免疫治疗策略。
